name: ReBirth: Rebuild & Resist
summary:
A province lies in ruins. An earthquake, a flood or years of drought have torn it apart, and an insurgency called the Shadow Front is filling the vacuum. You are the coordinator of an international stabilization mission. Rebuild the province, earn the people's trust, command your forces and end the war, ideally at the negotiating table rather than on the battlefield.

ReBirth is a 3D military strategy and management game about nation building and counter-insurgency. every road you repair, every clinic you open and every unit you deploy changes the stability, support and security of 14 districts.
